items.summary: A bus collided with a truck on Kenya’s main highway on Sunday, killing at least 22 people, police said.

items.title: North Korea sends letter to UN slamming Seoul over landmine blast
items.summary: North Korea sent a letter to the United Nations Security Council accusing Seoul of fabricating a landmine explosion that injured three South Korean soldiers, its state media reported Monday.
